description: A React component named GuardrailSelector that fetches and displays a list of guardrails for selection, using antd's Select component. It manages loading states, handles user selection, and dynamically loads options from a network request.

methods.name: GuardrailSelector
methods.description: React functional component that renders a multi-select dropdown for guardrails, fetching options from an API and notifying parent components of selection changes.

methods.name: fetchGuardrails
methods.description: Asynchronous function within useEffect to fetch guardrails list from server using provided accessToken.

methods.name: handleGuardrailChange
methods.description: Handles selection change events from the Select component, invoking the onChange callback with selected values.
